meta.name: nemo-curator
meta.description: GPU-accelerated data curation for LLM training. Supports text/image/video/audio. Features fuzzy deduplication (16× faster), quality filtering (30+ heuristics), semantic deduplication, PII redaction, NSFW detection. Scales across GPUs with RAPIDS. Use for preparing high-quality training datasets, cleaning web data, or deduplicating large corpora.

copy.tagline: 用GPU加速清洗和去重大规模训练数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为LLM训练准备高质量数据集
copy.tagline_en: Accelerate data curation and deduplication for LLM training with GPUs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare high-quality datasets for LLM training

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 GPU 加速处理文本、图片、视频、音频数据，用于训练大语言模型。它可以做模糊去重（比 CPU 快 16 倍）、质量过滤（30 多种规则）、语义去重、PII 脱敏、NSFW 检测等。
howto.when: 当你需要从网络爬取（如 Common Crawl）中准备高质量训练数据，或者要对大规模语料进行去重、过滤低质量或有害内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我用模糊去重清理这 8TB 的文本数据。
过滤掉这批文档中字数少于 50 的短文本。
say.note: 会使用 WordCountFilter 进行质量过滤。

say.text: 把数据集中的邮箱和电话号码替换掉。
say.note: 会使用 PIIRedactor 进行脱敏。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you process text, image, video, and audio data with GPU acceleration for LLM training. It supports fuzzy deduplication (16x faster than CPU), quality filtering (30+ heuristics), semantic deduplication, PII redaction, and NSFW detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to prepare high-quality training data from web scrapes (e.g., Common Crawl) or deduplicate/filter large corpora for low-quality or toxic content.

say_en.text: Help me fuzzy deduplicate this 8TB text dataset.
say_en.note: Calls FuzzyDuplicates module with GPU acceleration.

say_en.text: Filter out documents with fewer than 50 words.
Redact email addresses and phone numbers from the dataset.
